intro: 12 個存貨盤點情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: With the adjustments to the numbers of screws, we are close to having an accurate count.
ex.zh: 調整過螺絲的數量之後,我們的盤點數字已接近正確。

ex.en: An adjustment to the number of damaged items would help us align our figures.
ex.zh: 調整一下損壞品的數量,有助於讓我們的數字對齊。

note: make an adjustment to sth 對某事做調整
adjust 調整;adjustable 可調整的

ex.en: The computer automatically updates the inventory files when a sale is made.
ex.zh: 每完成一筆銷售,電腦就會自動更新存貨檔案。

ex.en: This door opens automatically so it's easier to carry large boxes out of the stockroom.
ex.zh: 這扇門會自動開啟,所以把大箱子搬出庫房比較容易。

note: automatic 自動的;automate 使自動化;automation 自動化

ex.en: Knowing how many products we have in stock is crucial to our shipping procedures.
ex.zh: 掌握我們有多少庫存商品,對出貨流程至關重要。

ex.en: Inventory is a crucial process and must be taken seriously by all staff.
ex.zh: 盤點是一項關鍵流程,全體員工都必須認真看待。

note: be crucial to / for sth 對⋯至關重要

ex.en: We easily explained the discrepancy between the two counts.
ex.zh: 我們輕易就解釋了兩次盤點數字之間的差異。

ex.en: Unless you catch the error immediately, the discrepancy gets entered into the computer and becomes very difficult to correct.
ex.zh: 除非你立刻抓到錯誤,否則這個差異會被輸入電腦,之後就很難更正。

note: a discrepancy between A and B A 與 B 之間的差異

ex.en: Let's see how many products we can count in advance of inventory so we disturb fewer customers.
ex.zh: 我們看看能在盤點前先清點多少商品,這樣可以少打擾一些顧客。

ex.en: Sorry to disturb you, but I need to ask you to move so I can record the products behind you.
ex.zh: 抱歉打擾了,麻煩您移動一下,我要記錄您身後的商品。

note: Sorry to disturb you 抱歉打擾
disturbance 干擾、騷動;disturbing 令人不安的

ex.en: Since we installed the new software, taking inventory has become a lot easier.
ex.zh: 自從我們安裝了新軟體,盤點變得容易多了。

ex.en: We'll need to get the new computers installed before we can take inventory.
ex.zh: 我們得先把新電腦裝好,才能進行盤點。

note: get sth installed 把某物安裝好
installation 安裝;installment 分期付款

ex.en: The numbers on the computer log should accurately reflect the actual numbers in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 電腦紀錄上的數字應該準確反映倉庫裡的實際數量。

ex.en: The way you handled the problems with the inventory reflects your professional attitude.
ex.zh: 你處理盤點問題的方式,反映出你的專業態度。

note: reflection 反映、倒影;reflective 反思的

ex.en: As long as the computer is running, you can keep adding new data.
ex.zh: 只要電腦還在運作,你就可以繼續新增資料。

ex.en: The new cash registers look complicated but they are actually quite easy to run.
ex.zh: 新的收銀機看起來很複雜,但其實操作起來相當容易。

note: run a business 經營事業;run a machine 操作機器
不規則變化 run–ran–run;running 重複子音

ex.en: Jasmine quickly scanned the list to see if any information was missing.
ex.zh: 潔絲敏快速瀏覽了清單,看看有沒有遺漏任何資訊。

ex.en: When we take inventory, we have to scan each item number into the computer.
ex.zh: 盤點時,我們必須把每個品項編號掃描進電腦。

ex.en: Once you ring up an item, the computer automatically subtracts it from the inventory log.
ex.zh: 你一結帳某件商品,電腦就會自動從存貨紀錄中扣除它。

ex.en: Whoever did the inventory forgot to subtract the damaged items.
ex.zh: 負責盤點的人忘了把損壞品扣掉。

note: subtract A from B 從 B 中減去 A

ex.en: This is tedious work, but you will be glad the inventory is accurate when you hit the holiday season.
ex.zh: 這是很乏味的工作,但等到假期旺季來臨,你會慶幸存貨數字是正確的。

ex.en: Counting merchandise all weekend is the most tedious job I can imagine.
ex.zh: 整個週末都在清點商品,是我能想像最乏味的工作。

ex.en: I can't verify the accuracy of these numbers, since I was not present for inventory weekend.
ex.zh: 我無法證實這些數字是否正確,因為盤點那個週末我不在場。

ex.en: The inventory process verifies that all the items are accounted for.
ex.zh: 盤點流程會確認所有品項都有著落。

note: be accounted for 有下落、有交代
